verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no participant-notification, in-meeting disclosure, or consent-capture feature. The only nearby item is a Rules Engine for admin control over meeting access and privacy, which is an adjacent access-control feature, not consent or transparency tooling for participants. That earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Automation workflows for admins to have control over meeting access and privacy.
